player_prompt.intro:
Inti Player {player_id} fil-Whist Ġermaniż.
{phase_info}
Int għandek {hand_size} karti.
Lagħab karta bil-'[play N]', fejn N huwa l-pożizzjoni tagħha fl-idejk (pereżempju '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Kull trick minn issa 'l quddiem jgħodd għall-rebħa.

next_card.playing_phase: M'hemm l-ebda karta offruta - il-fażi tal-logħob bdiet.
next_card.deck_empty: Il- gverta hija vojta - m'hemm l- ebda karta offruta.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format ta 'mover invalidu. Uża' [play N] 'biex tilgħab l-Nth karta f'idejk.
invalid_move.bad_position: Dik il-pożizzjoni tal-karta ma teżistix. Għandek {hand_size} karti f'idejk.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Għandek issegwi l-eżempju u tilgħab karta {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Din il- karta ma tistax tintlagħab.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: Il-gverta hija eżawrita. L-istadju tat-tagħlim huwa fuq - kull trick li jibqa 'jgħodd lejn ir-rebħa.

draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
